report.summary: The test user successfully navigated from the homepage to the projects page and opened a project detail. No journey errors or broken interactions were recorded. The primary risks are invisible to users: AI crawlers and link previews see empty pages because all content requires JavaScript, accessibility violations block screen readers, and security headers are missing.

findings.fix: Fix each listed element so it passes the aria-prohibited-attr rule, then rerun this journey.
findings.title: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes
findings.detail: The real-browser audit found the aria-prohibited-attr rule failing on 2 elements: .say, .ptag.

findings.fix: Fix each listed element so it passes the color-contrast rule, then rerun this journey.
findings.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
findings.detail: The real-browser audit found the color-contrast rule failing on 2 elements: div:nth-child(1) > dt, .phero > .label.mono.

findings.fix: Prerender the homepage (static generation or server rendering), or at least put a real h1, description and a short paragraph about the product in index.html.
findings.title: Homepage content only appears after JavaScript runs
findings.detail: The server sends 2772 bytes of HTML with 0 characters of visible text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript, so ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity see an empty page. Link previews on WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Slack do too. Google runs JavaScript but indexes it later.

findings.fix: Reduce render-blocking work and optimize the largest above-the-fold element.
findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint is slow
findings.detail: A single browser visit observed LCP at 2884 ms; the good threshold is 2500 ms. This is not a Lighthouse lab run or population field p75. No resource attribution was captured.

findings.fix: Add a short description of what this page offers and for whom. There is no required length.
findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.detail: In the HTML sent before JavaScript runs: No meta description. Advisory: search engines usually build snippets from page text, and link previews often show the description when it exists. Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

findings.fix: Prerender these routes too, starting with pricing, features and docs.
findings.title: 2 more pages only render with JavaScript
findings.detail: AI crawlers see these pages as empty: https://portfolio2-mu-inky.vercel.app/dial/projects.html, https://portfolio2-mu-inky.vercel.app/dial/work.html?p=walkthru

findings.fix: Add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD to the homepage, plus SoftwareApplication or Product where you describe the product.
findings.title: No structured data
findings.detail: Your pages have no JSON-LD. Structured data tells AI assistants exactly what your product is, who makes it and what it costs.

findings.fix: Start with default-src 'self' and add sources as needed; use report-only first.
findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy
findings.detail: Without a CSP, any injected script runs with full access to the page. Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

findings.fix: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.
findings.title: Page can be framed
findings.detail: Another site can embed this page and trick users into clicking (clickjacking). Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

findings.fix: Describe this page and the brand in the title. There is no required length.
findings.title: Page title is too short
findings.detail: In the HTML sent before JavaScript runs: The title is "Rohit Maity" (11 characters). Advisory: a very short title may say little about the page. Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

findings.fix: Add one main heading that states what the page is about.
findings.title: No h1 heading
findings.detail: In the HTML sent before JavaScript runs: The page has no top-level heading. Advisory: a clear main heading helps visitors and screen-reader users find the topic; search engines also read prominent headings. Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing at the preferred URL.
findings.title: No canonical link
findings.detail: In the HTML sent before JavaScript runs: Without a canonical URL, variants like ?utm= or trailing slashes can split ranking signals. Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

findings.fix: Generate /sitemap.xml and reference it from robots.txt.
findings.title: No sitemap.xml
findings.detail: Search engines discover pages slower without a sitemap.

findings.fix: Give each page its own title; for true duplicates, pick one URL and point the others at it with rel=canonical or a redirect.
findings.title: Duplicate title
findings.detail: Several pages share the same title, so search engines cannot tell them apart and may show only one. Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

findings.fix: Add /llms.txt: an H1 with your name, a one-line > summary, then sections of links to your key pages.
findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.detail: llms.txt is a short Markdown map of your site for AI tools. It has low measured impact on AI search today, so fix the items above first.

findings.fix: Publish a plain-text /.well-known/ai.txt describing the site and linking to its key pages.
findings.title: No /.well-known/ai.txt
findings.detail: This optional AI discovery file is absent or serves HTML. Its effect on AI search is not established; fix crawler access and content first.

findings.fix: Publish a plain-text /llms-full.txt describing the site and linking to its key pages.
findings.title: No /llms-full.txt
findings.detail: This optional AI discovery file is absent or serves HTML. Its effect on AI search is not established; fix crawler access and content first.

findings.title: No X-Content-Type-Options
findings.detail: Browsers may sniff file types and run a text file as script. Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

findings.title: No Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: Full URLs, including query strings, leak to every site you link to. Found on 3 of 3 audited pages.

top_fixes: Prerender the homepage, projects page, and project detail pages (static generation or server rendering) so AI crawlers and link previews see real content.
Remove or correct the prohibited ARIA attributes on the .say and .ptag elements to pass accessibility audits.
Add a Content-Security-Policy header starting with default-src 'self' in report-only mode, then enforce it.
Increase color contrast on the failing elements (div:nth-child(1) > dt and .phero > .label.mono) to meet WCAG AA.
Add unique meta descriptions to all three pages to improve search snippets and social previews.
